questions.question: Against which city is the oracle in Isaiah 17?
What will Damascus become, according to Isaiah 17?
options: A heap of ruins, ceasing to be a city
A place of refuge for the scattered exiles
A center of trade for many nations
A fortified stronghold no army can take
questions.answer: A heap of ruins, ceasing to be a city

questions.question: Isaiah 17 says in that day people will look to their Maker rather than to the altars their hands have made.
Behold, _____ will cease to be a city and will become a heap of ruins.
In that day man will look to his _____, and his eyes will look on the Holy One of Israel.
